Plot fitted sparse functional mean and retained PACE component deviation

etr_plot_sparse_fpca_component.Rd

Uses the genuine native sparse functional PACE mean and covariance eigensystem. Mean plus/minus standard-deviation mode uses the fitted eigenvalue and eigenfunction, never a substituted fdapace marginal estimator. Direct Python 1.2 Matplotlib artist line data can be compared, but rendered pixel geometry and Python runtime class identity differ.

Usage

etr_plot_sparse_fpca_component(result, component = 0L,
    sd_multiplier = 2, strict_source_record = FALSE)

Arguments

result

Native univariate sparse covariance/PACE fit with a mean, joint estimation-grid covariance, eigenvalues and eigenfunctions.

component

Zero-based retained functional principal-component index, as in frozen Python 1.2.

sd_multiplier

Finite strictly positive standard deviation multiple of the retained principal component.

strict_source_record

Return an ordered native R scientific Matplotlib line-artist data record with mean, mean minus mode and mean plus mode, source labels and axis titles. No actual Python Axes object is created.

Value

By default, invisible time, mean, lower and upper curve data frame. Strict mode returns an inspectable source-scientific geometry record describing three labelled native R plotted lines, matching the frozen Python plotting order.
